criteria.requirement: Replace JSON-handler line-delimiter splitting with real JSON-object boundary recognition. Accept compact, empty, pretty and nested objects, escaped braces/quotes, non-ASCII metadata and a body that itself contains braces or JSON-looking lines. Consume exactly the first complete object and preserve the trailing body. Keep actual JSONHandler attachment, reserved business metadata, existing JSON serialization options and malformed-JSON exceptions. Non-object arbitrary prose remains ordinary content; no YAML/TOML behavior regression.
